status: PRE-REGISTERED after C1/C2/C3 evaluation and BEFORE any integrated forecast error was computed
component_choice: validated components only: ASP from C1-M2 (pass). Failed components use their strongest benchmark: sales volume = C2 B2 seasonal (q-4); unit cost ex-royalty = C3 B1 last quarter. Royalty = effective royalty rate of q-1 x forecast coal revenue.
target: quarterly gross profit on coal revenue basis (USD m) = FS coal revenue - FS cost of revenue (incl. royalty), standalone quarter. Narrowed scope: EBITDA, operating profit and net profit to owners are NOT tested (D&A, SG&A, other income and tax lines not extracted).
forecast: GP_hat = V_hat x ASP_hat x (1 - r_(q-1)) - V_hat x UC_hat, with V in Mt, ASP and UC in USD/t

benchmarks.G3_same_structure_without_C1: identical formula but ASP_hat = C1 strongest benchmark B4 (last ASP x Newcastle change) - isolates C1's contribution

origin: quarter end + 10 days; same information set as C1/C2/C3; no actual future volumes or costs
evaluation: common sample (>= 2021Q1); MAE, RMSE, bias, OOS R2, directional accuracy vs q-1; DM (HAC, HLN) one-sided vs strongest benchmark and separately vs G3; bootstrap CI
uncertainty: empirical 10/90% quantiles of walk-forward GP errors reported (joint error of components, no independence assumption)
pass_rule: n >= 16 AND MAE(I1) <= 0.85 x MAE(strongest benchmark) AND one-sided DM p <= 0.05 (single model; programme-wide Holm reported)
C1_translation: C1 translates materially if MAE(I1) <= 0.85 x MAE(G3) with DM p <= 0.05
